biotools.summary: The HUPA corpus is a large, open-access clinical dataset containing sustained-vowel voice recordings and associated metadata from 440 native Castilian Spanish speakers, used for detecting voice disorders. It includes both audio recordings and expert subjective evaluations using the GRBAS scale.
